text:
sam: Kicking off a narrow-cut RC for model-service v2.3.1-rc. Includes q2 perf fixes + KV-cache warm improvements. Change window 2026-03-21 15:00-17:00 PST. Requesting QA + Security + Oncall ack and a pin. deploy-bot will create the artifact and tag it.

deploy-bot: artifact built: rsvc-2.3.1-rc-20260321 (sha: abc123def). CI: unit ✅ integ ✅ smoke pending. proposed pins: candidate=pin_789 fallback=pin_456.

elena: Starting smoke now on a small canary subset. smoke command: `./smoke.sh rsvc-2.3.1-rc --canary 5%`

elena: smoke green. 95p latency ~190ms, error rate 0.2% on canary. no obvious regressions on my quick checks.

sarah: quick security config review done, no new scopes or secrets. noted we should rotate ephemeral key after promo.

mike: Oncall here — confirm KV-warm script is included and we'll pre-warm 10 nodes before traffic shift. plan: canary 5% for 30m -> 50% for 30m -> 100% ramp. abort if error rate > 2% or latency P95 jumps > 2x.

sam: KV-warm included (`scripts/kv_warm.sh`) and deploy plan matches mike's. Release notes short: perf fix for attention kernel, KV warm, telemetry tagging for rollout. Dina already drafted notes.

dina: Product ack +1 on release notes. small UX note captured but not blocking.

deploy-bot: promo scheduled at 2026-03-21T15:05:00-08:00. rollout ticket: https://redwood.atl/rollouts/RC-20260321-001 

mike: I'll be watching the rollout. Quick rollback snippet for docs: ```kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/model-service --to-revision=REV && curl -X POST https://ops-api/revert -d '{"pin":"pin_456"}'``` Keep that handy.

elena: QA will run the golden eval set after the 5% canary completes. If regen mismatch > 3% hold promo.

sam: stamping candidate pin now. @deploy-bot please set candidate pin to pin_789 and ensure fallback pin_456 is available.

deploy-bot: pins set — candidate: pin_789, fallback: pin_456. Artifact pinned to promo ticket. Reaction: :white_check_mark:

mike: Approved from oncall. go/no-go window open.

sam: Promo in T-10. speak now if you need a hold.

sarah: no holds from security.

dina: no holds from product.

sam: launching promo. will report back after canary and KV-warm success. thanks all. :rocket:
